name: Unity Android Development APK Verification
requiredSequence: Run static and baseline verification on a separate clean extraction before Unity import; do not run the sealed-source verifier in the imported working copy
Open a different working copy of the exact candidate in Unity 6000.5.9f1, save the Unity-generated ProjectSettings.asset, and let Package Manager resolve Packages/packages-lock.json
Treat import-generated .meta files, Library, Logs, UserSettings, and other Unity working-copy state as outside the sealed 457-file source fingerprint

Return only the unedited ProjectSettings.asset and packages-lock.json; retain and review the lock for no embedded, local, or Git dependency, then source-pin its SHA-256 before attempting preflight or an APK build
Continue only on the resulting lock-pinned frozen candidate; the current unpinned source is intentionally build-blocked
Configure the exact nonproduction Development APK values from the manual checklist without adding signing credentials
Compile with zero errors and retain the Unity Console evidence
Run the project validator and v1.17 Step 1 Editor self-test and retain both results
Run every EditMode and PlayMode test and retain both NUnit XML files with zero failed, skipped, or inconclusive tests
Pass the sanitized Development APK preflight on the same frozen bytes

In a throwaway copy, retain fail-closed denial evidence for Android requests with extraScriptingDefines, an empty or alternate scene list, an extra Build Options flag, an AssetBundle manifest, and an inactive custom Build Profile
Build only the exact permitted debug-signed Development APK and retain its BuildReport and SHA-256
Review the merged manifest, ARM64 native inventory, 16 KB compatibility, and representative-device behavior
exitCriteria: Every later Unity evidence item is tied to the reviewed source-archive SHA-256, policy hash, and the explicitly retained ProjectSettings.asset and packages-lock.json, not literal post-import 457-file equality
The resolved Packages/packages-lock.json is reviewed, included in the candidate, and SHA-256 pinned by both the live guard and static verifier
Scheduled per-build defines and active or inactive custom Build Profiles are rejected before Android compilation
The scheduled Android target, subtarget, scenes, output, Build Options, and AssetBundle manifest match the exact development-only contract
No release APK, AAB, Gradle export, custom signing, production identity, provider, economy activation, or commercial activation is enabled
The exact Development APK runs on representative Android hardware without blocking the offline core loop
The generated ProjectSettings.asset contains no serialized credential or unapproved production value
hardStop: The current source cannot build an APK until the resolved package lock is reviewed and source-pinned. Passing the later checkpoint authorizes only a local debug-signed Development APK; it never enables production signing, AAB, Play publishing, economy authority, or commercial providers.
nextDevelopmentMilestone: v1.17 Step 2 — Save Migration and Recovery Foundation
